To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
supervised learning to rank and rank aggregation techniques are both adequate to combine multiple estimators of expert knowledge.

1) the supervised learning to rank approaches are better than rank aggregation approaches for combining different sources of expertise; 2) the pairwise approaches are better than pointwise or listwise approaches; and 3) the combination of multiple sources of expertise improves the quality of the results.
